grading.2: All central visual criteria are visible
grading.1: A substantial part of the visual request is visible
grading.unknown: The available image does not support a confident decision

pool: Union of the first 15 candidates per strategy and the listed visual examples, displayed in an order independent of rank and strategy. Recall is relative to known positives. Unjudged items contribute zero gain, with coverage reported separately.
development: A plate or flat serving dish. Deep bowls or vessels are partial.

evaluation: A visible flat plate for serving food, including a plate in a still life. A visibly deep bowl or unrelated vessel is partial only if it functions as tableware.

Both subjects on the same hanging scroll. One visible subject or an indistinct possible second subject is partial.
Drawn or sketched artworks. Paintings with substantial drawing or prints over linework may be partial.
Recognizable boats beside a recognizable shore. Watercraft at sea or a shoreline without boats is partial.
A recognizable red flower attached to a stem or branch. Flowers of other colors are partial.
A recognizable child's portrait with a visible pacifier. A child without a pacifier is partial.
A recognizable zebra wearing a spacesuit. Only a zebra in a closely related setting can earn partial credit.
A shallow dish for serving food
A visible shallow plate or serving dish. A visibly deep bowl may be partial.
Close-up portrait of a crested parrot
A recognizable crested parrot shown close up. Other close-up parrot portraits or a similar crested bird are partial.
A portrait with a predominantly yellow backdrop
The backdrop behind the visible portrait subject must be predominantly yellow. A yellow object or multicolored backdrop alone is insufficient.
Stone arch bridge over a stream
A visible arched stone bridge crossing a stream. A stone bridge or a stream without the conjunction is partial if a meaningful visual component is visible.
A black and white repeating pattern
A repeating design in grayscale without strong hue. A color repeat or monochrome graphic without repetition can be partial.
A person wearing a cap with a visible beard
A person wearing a cap or hat with a visible beard. A beard without a cap or a cap without a beard is partial.
A recognizable landscape with characteristic soft watercolor rendering. Graphic landscapes or watercolor works of another subject are partial.
Visible costume whose substantial area is blue or turquoise with visible embroidery. Blue on a minor piece or embroidered garments of another color are partial.
An X-ray of a bicycle inside a volcano
A recognizable bicycle in an X-ray-like view inside a volcano. Only a bicycle or X-ray in a closely related depiction can earn partial credit.
